app.title: oh-goon
app.subtitle: Prepare, update, verify, and understand every local uv repository from one place.

privacy.title: Local by design
privacy.summary: oh-goon runs entirely on this machine. Harmless UI preferences such as language may be stored in the local browser; repository state and history are owned by the local SQLite-backed FastAPI backend.
privacy.networkNote: Git and uv may contact your configured remotes, package indexes, and security audit services during operations. oh-goon does not upload your source code.

locations.dialogLabel: Choose a folder that contains your local repositories

locations.unavailableMessage: {{count}} configured repository location is not currently accessible. Repositories inside it are absent from the current catalog; this is not an execution failure.

exclusions.title: {{count}} repository excluded
exclusions.message: Excluded repositories are listed below for visibility, but Initialize, Plan, Update, Verify, Git, uv, audit, and pytest checks do not inspect or modify them.

operations.title: Run fleet maintenance
operations.description: Initialize checks fast readiness. Plan previews the deterministic update. Update runs the full dependency run. Verify rechecks the current repository state.
operations.scopeHint: Runs only on {{count}} included repositories. Excluded repositories are never inspected.
operations.initFirst: Initialize first: {{ready}} of {{count}} included repositories are READY.
operations.staleHint: {{stale}} of {{count}} included repositories changed after Initialize. Run Initialize again before Plan or Update.

EXCLUDED.what: Repository is outside the active fleet scope.
EXCLUDED.reason: You excluded this repository from oh-goon checks.
EXCLUDED.impact: Initialize, Plan, Update, Verify, Git, uv, audit, and pytest do not inspect or modify it.
EXCLUDED.nextAction: Include the repository when it should participate in fleet maintenance again.

NOT_CHECKED.what: Repository readiness has not been checked in this session.
NOT_CHECKED.reason: Initialize has not produced a current readiness result yet.
NOT_CHECKED.impact: Plan and Update remain blocked for this repository.

READY.what: Repository is ready for dependency maintenance.
READY.impact: Plan and Update may run, subject to their own deterministic revalidation.

READINESS_STALE.what: The previous readiness result is no longer current.
READINESS_STALE.reason: A later operation changed or revalidated repository state after Initialize.
READINESS_STALE.impact: oh-goon will not reuse the old readiness result for a new Plan or Update.

DIRTY_WORKTREE.reason: The working tree was not clean when readiness was checked.
DIRTY_WORKTREE.impact: oh-goon will not switch branches or update dependencies while local work could be overwritten or mixed into the update.
DIRTY_WORKTREE.nextAction: Commit, stash, or discard the local changes, then run Initialize again.

UV_LOCK_MISSING.what: The repository does not have a uv.lock file.
UV_LOCK_MISSING.reason: oh-goon requires an existing lockfile before fleet maintenance begins.
UV_LOCK_MISSING.impact: The deterministic update run cannot establish the expected baseline.
UV_LOCK_MISSING.nextAction: Create and review the initial uv.lock for this project, then run Initialize again.

TOOLING_REQUIRED.what: Required local tooling is not ready.
TOOLING_REQUIRED.reason: A required tool is missing, broken, or outside the supported version range.
TOOLING_REQUIRED.impact: oh-goon cannot safely execute the repository operation.
TOOLING_REQUIRED.nextAction: Open System Health, fix the reported tool issue, then run Initialize again.

REMOTE_AHEAD.what: The local default branch contains commits not present on its remote.
REMOTE_AHEAD.reason: The repository is ahead of the configured upstream.
REMOTE_AHEAD.impact: oh-goon will not push local commits or decide how they should be published.
REMOTE_AHEAD.nextAction: Review and publish or otherwise resolve the local commits manually, then run Initialize again.

REMOTE_DIVERGED.what: The local and remote default branches have diverged.
REMOTE_DIVERGED.reason: Both sides contain commits the other side does not have.
REMOTE_DIVERGED.impact: Automatic merge, rebase, reset, or force-push would require a human Git decision.
REMOTE_DIVERGED.nextAction: Resolve the branch divergence manually, then run Initialize again.

REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE.what: oh-goon could not establish a usable remote baseline.
REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The remote or upstream was unavailable or not configured as required.
REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE.impact: oh-goon cannot confirm that dependency work starts from the expected shared branch state.
REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE.nextAction: Fix the remote/upstream or network access, then run Initialize again.

DEPENDENCIES_UPDATED.reason: New compatible dependency versions were selected.
DEPENDENCIES_UPDATED.impact: The changed lockfile must be reviewed and the repository readiness must be re-established before another fleet update cycle.
DEPENDENCIES_UPDATED.nextAction: Review the dependency diff and validation result, commit the accepted update, then run Initialize again.

NO_UPDATES.reason: The current lockfile already satisfies the selected update policy.
NO_UPDATES.impact: There is no dependency diff to review for this update run.
NO_UPDATES.nextAction: Run Initialize before starting another fleet update cycle.

TESTS_FAILED.what: Dependency processing completed but repository tests failed.
TESTS_FAILED.reason: uv run --frozen pytest returned a failing result after the operation.
TESTS_FAILED.impact: The dependency state should not be accepted until the regression is understood.
TESTS_FAILED.nextAction: Review the failing tests and dependency changes before deciding whether to fix or roll back the update.

VULNERABILITIES_FOUND.what: The security audit found known vulnerabilities.
VULNERABILITIES_FOUND.reason: The resolved dependency set matched one or more vulnerability records.
VULNERABILITIES_FOUND.impact: The dependency result requires security review before it should be accepted.
VULNERABILITIES_FOUND.nextAction: Review the reported vulnerabilities and update or explicitly handle the affected dependencies.

AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE.what: The security audit could not complete.
AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The configured audit capability or vulnerability service was unavailable.
AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE.impact: Security status is unknown for this run; it is not equivalent to a passed audit.
AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE.nextAction: Restore audit availability and rerun Verify or Update according to your policy.

LOCK_DRIFT.reason: A later update phase modified the lockfile that was supposed to remain fixed.
LOCK_DRIFT.impact: The deterministic update invariant was broken and the resulting state cannot be trusted.
LOCK_DRIFT.nextAction: Inspect the technical evidence and run commands before retrying the update.

UNEXPECTED_FILE_CHANGES.what: Tracked files changed outside the allowed dependency update.
UNEXPECTED_FILE_CHANGES.reason: The update detected worktree changes other than the intended lockfile result.
UNEXPECTED_FILE_CHANGES.impact: The update may have mixed unrelated generated or test changes into the repository.
UNEXPECTED_FILE_CHANGES.nextAction: Review the changed files and restore or intentionally handle them before retrying.

GIT_POSITION_CHANGED.what: The repository Git position changed during the operation.
GIT_POSITION_CHANGED.reason: HEAD no longer matches the commit captured at the start of the deterministic run.
GIT_POSITION_CHANGED.impact: Validation no longer refers to the same source revision that was originally checked.
GIT_POSITION_CHANGED.nextAction: Inspect the Git history and restore a known branch state before running Initialize again.

VERIFICATION_FAILED.what: The dependency update did not satisfy all verification gates.
VERIFICATION_FAILED.reason: One or more deterministic validation checks failed.
VERIFICATION_FAILED.impact: The resulting dependency state should not be accepted as ready.
VERIFICATION_FAILED.nextAction: Open the technical details, fix the failing gate, and rerun the appropriate run.

OPERATION_FAILED.reason: oh-goon could not complete the operation successfully.
OPERATION_FAILED.impact: The repository state has not been accepted by the canonical run.
OPERATION_FAILED.nextAction: Review the technical output and reported evidence, fix the cause, then retry.

MANUAL_ACTION_REQUIRED.what: oh-goon stopped before making an unsafe decision.
MANUAL_ACTION_REQUIRED.reason: The repository needs a human decision that is outside the safe automatic policy.
MANUAL_ACTION_REQUIRED.impact: The affected run remains blocked, but oh-goon will not guess or perform destructive Git actions.
MANUAL_ACTION_REQUIRED.nextAction: Review the repository details, resolve the reported condition manually, then run Initialize again.

ENGINE_CONTRACT_INVALID.what: oh-goon received an engine report that does not match the canonical contract.
ENGINE_CONTRACT_INVALID.reason: The deterministic engine and application schema are out of sync.
ENGINE_CONTRACT_INVALID.impact: The operation result is rejected instead of being interpreted with an incompatible schema.
ENGINE_CONTRACT_INVALID.nextAction: Update or repair oh-goon so the engine and application use the same version, then retry.

ENGINE_REPORT_MISSING.what: The engine did not produce the required structured operation report.
ENGINE_REPORT_MISSING.reason: The command ended without a valid canonical machine result.
ENGINE_REPORT_MISSING.impact: oh-goon cannot safely infer repository state from terminal text.
ENGINE_REPORT_MISSING.nextAction: Review the technical diagnostic, repair the engine/tooling issue, and retry.

REVIEW_PREPARED.reason: oh-goon created a local branch and commit after the deterministic update gates passed.
REVIEW_PREPARED.impact: The dependency change is ready for human review without pushing anything remotely.
REVIEW_PREPARED.nextAction: Review the local commit, then push or open a pull request when you choose.

MIGRATION_APPLIED.reason: UV project metadata and lock state were generated and validated.
MIGRATION_APPLIED.impact: The migration is committed on a local review branch; nothing was pushed.
MIGRATION_APPLIED.nextAction: Review the local migration commit, then push it when you are ready.

provenance.title: Current state provenance
provenance.description: Identifies the exact durable-state and journal revisions used to build this browser snapshot.

history.title: Fleet run history
history.description: Review durable past runs and open the exact operation reports accepted by each run.
history.emptyMessage: Run Initialize, Plan, Update, or Verify to create durable history.
history.selectRun: Select a run to inspect repository results and technical evidence.
history.reinitializeBeforeRerun: Initialize the included repositories again before rerunning this action.
history.pageDescription: Open past runs when you need to inspect what happened. Repositories starts repository CI/CD; Runs → New shared run runs one selected Plan across explicit repositories; Schedules starts time-triggered runs.
history.inspectBeforeRetry: Inspect these repositories before starting replacement work; oh-goon will not replay an uncertain attempt automatically.
history.enforcerReceiptHint: Stable non-secret run receipt for diffing/debugging.
history.noMatches: No loaded runs match this view.

runGrid.title: Run grid (loaded summary)
runGrid.help: Secondary comparison of loaded Run facts only. Open a Run or Run Diff for canonical Step-level timing and failure evidence.

history.runAgainBlockedActive: Finish or cancel the current run/change before starting this run again.
history.runAgainBlockedNoRepositories: No repositories from this run are currently included.

gameTape.title: Game Tape
gameTape.description: See the admitted Game Plan and the durable facts from what actually ran.
gameTape.contract: Flow shows plan order; Timeline shows recorded timing. Neither view schedules, reorders, or changes execution.

summary.title: Overview
summary.technicalEvidenceHelp: Exact plan identity, execution receipts, observability limits, plan-vs-actual facts and environment fingerprints are preserved here for deeper review.

flow.title: Steps
flow.heading: Plan → Goons → Steps
flow.description: Follow the exact admitted CI/CD sequence for each repository. Use the lane navigator for larger runs and select any Step to inspect its durable execution evidence.
flow.truth: Arrows show admitted Step order. Repository lanes are execution views, not a DAG scheduler; Goon groups come only from recorded Step source provenance.
flow.findHelp: Search highlights matching Steps; nothing is hidden. Enter moves to the next match, Shift+Enter to the previous.
flow.lanePosition: Step {{current}} of {{total}} in this repository lane
flow.groupStatusSummary: Recorded Step statuses for this source segment
flow.segmentPosition: Source segment {{current}} of {{total}} in this repository lane
flow.keyboardHelp: Keyboard: when a Step is focused, Left/Right moves within this repository lane; Home/End moves to its first/last Step.
flow.collapsedLaneSummary: {{steps}} Steps remain available across {{segments}} recorded source segments
flow.collapsedLaneHelp: Details hidden by you. Use Show lane details to reopen the complete recorded pipeline.
flow.collapsedLaneStatuses: Recorded Step statuses in the hidden lane
flow.planMetaDetailed: {{repositories}} repositories · {{steps}} planned Steps · {{segments}} recorded source segments
flow.repositoryScopeTruth: No cross-repository execution order is asserted by this view.
flow.laneStatusSummary: Recorded Step statuses for this repository lane
flow.collapsePassedPage: Collapse Passed lanes on this page

outputs.title: Outputs
outputs.empty: No artifact or published output evidence was recorded for this run.
outputs.contract: Outputs are projected from canonical Step evidence. This view does not inspect the repository or reconstruct artifacts in the browser.

verification.title: Verification
verification.heading: Verification selection and execution
verification.contract: Hashmarks owns logical verification membership. Oh-Goon admits that producer contract and owns physical execution and results; this view joins the recorded identities without recreating selection semantics.
verification.unavailable: No Hashmarks verification-selection execution evidence was recorded for this run.
verification.membersUnavailable: This historical run does not retain the explicit selected-member projection.
verification.complete: Actual execution membership completely covers the admitted selection.
verification.incomplete: Actual execution membership is incomplete for the admitted selection.
verification.implementationProvenanceContract: Derived directly from the installed Hashmarks producer for explanation only. It is not persisted and cannot grant repository or execution authority.

enforcer.title: Enforcer
enforcer.unavailable: This run does not have an Enforcer receipt.
enforcer.contract: Enforcer availability is a backend Game Tape fact. The receipt is the stable non-secret authority/debugging projection for strict CI/CD execution.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.unavailable: No wall-clock step timing was recorded for this run.
timeline.truth: Bars use recorded wall-clock timing on a fixed-width elapsed scale. Very short Steps are not visually widened; the endpoint puck keeps them visible. Color reinforces status; the symbol and status text remain the meaning.

performance.title: Performance
performance.unavailable: No Game Tape performance facts are available for this run.
performance.contract: Performance is calculated on demand from prior durable Game Tape timing facts. No metrics database, anomaly model, or AI interpretation is used.
performance.rule: Baseline: same plan and repository, successful completed timing only, newest samples first.
performance.candidates: {{comparable}} same-plan runs found in {{considered}} earlier runs
performance.resourcesUnavailable: No Scout resource evidence is retained for this Run.

logs.title: Logs
logs.privacy: oh-goon never persists raw stdout/stderr in run history. Active output and a short sealed terminal handoff may be shown process-locally; durable line, byte, and SHA-256 evidence remains after it expires.
logs.liveUnavailable: No live raw output is available for this run. Historical raw stdout/stderr is not retained.
logs.liveTransient: Process-local only. Redacted before exposure; terminal output is sealed for a short handoff window and never written to history.
logs.liveEmpty: No output has been emitted for this step yet.
logs.droppedChunks: {{count}} earlier output chunks were dropped from the bounded live buffer.
logs.rawDisclosureHelp: Open transient raw output only when you need the exact lines. Structured Step facts and durable evidence stay visible above.
logs.structuredFirst: Understand the recorded Step result first; raw output is one level deeper.
logs.noMatches: No retained output matches these filters.
logs.boundedWindow: At most {{count}} matching chunks are rendered at once. Earlier/Newer keeps every loaded chunk reviewable without an unbounded log DOM.
logs.durableOutputEvidenceHelp: Line counts, bytes and SHA-256 are the durable truth after raw output is no longer available.
logs.selectStepHelp: Select a Step in the list to review its recorded outcome, exact failure evidence and any available raw output.

nativeAgent.title: Native agent observations
nativeAgent.claimRule: Native events are agent claims. Process exit, cancellation and verification retain their recorded Step results. Prompt and response text is not retained here.

inspector.title: Step inspector
inspector.secretRule: Sources are visible; secret and literal values are never included in the Game Tape payload.
inspector.technicalDetailsHelp: Exact identity, command, working directory, attempts, environment and outputs. These facts are unchanged; they are simply one level deeper.
inspector.failureKeyboardHint: Alt+↑ previous failure · Alt+↓ next failure · Esc close
inspector.authorityProjectionRule: Diagnostic projection only. Execution authority remains owned by the original admission, materialization and runtime receipts.

receipt.title: What oh-goon can prove
receipt.guarantees: Ordered plan only · no hidden retries · no automatic reordering · no undeclared steps.

planActual.title: What was supposed to run vs what happened

environment.title: What exactly ran this
environment.toolVersionsUnavailable: Tool version strings are not persisted for this run. Game Tape does not infer them.

failure.title: Failure fingerprint
failure.rawUnavailable: Raw stdout/stderr is not persisted in run history, so Game Tape cannot invent a log line or source location. Durable output hashes remain available above.
failure.rawPolicy: Raw output is transient. If the bounded terminal handoff is still retained, Logs opens the recorded failure line; durable hashes/counts remain after expiry.
failure.liveAnchorReady: Transient {{stream}} line {{line}} is retained and highlighted above.
failure.liveAnchorDropped: The durable failure anchor is {{stream}} line {{line}}, but that transient line is no longer retained in the bounded buffer.
failure.navigationDegraded: Failure navigation could not be derived, but the raw transient log remains available.

search.title: Search
search.label: Search Game Tape
search.scope: Search reads the authoritative Game Tape payload directly and includes currently available transient logs. Raw historical logs are not retained or indexed.

diff.title: Run Diff
diff.sharedScaleTruth: Baseline and current use exactly the same X-axis scale. Neither bar is independently stretched to fill the chart.
diff.stepScaleTruth: Every baseline/current Step bar below uses this one X-axis scale. No Step pair is independently stretched.

playByPlay.title: Play-by-Play
playByPlay.contract: Chronological events are projected from the admitted plan and durable run/operation/step facts. This view cannot trigger or reorder work.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.contract: Each attempt is projected from durable executor evidence. Game Tape does not replay commands, infer missing values, or create a second retry model.
attempts.reproduceRule: These are the exact durable identities and command facts oh-goon recorded. Environment values and repository bytes are not reconstructed from hashes.
attempts.valuesUnavailable: Game Tape preserves source names and immutable identities, not secret/literal environment values. Match these identities before claiming an execution was reproduced.
attempts.none: No physical attempt evidence exists because this planned step was not executed.
attempts.retryLinked: explicitly linked by the recorded retry decision
attempts.repositoryContinuous: repository state carried into the next attempt
attempts.authFileReadWrite: Codex auth file: readable and writable by agent/tools
attempts.retryContextRule: Classification uses only adjacent canonical attempt evidence. Output/exit changes do not count as a physical execution-context change.

retryContext.SAME_PHYSICAL_CONTEXT: retried in the same physical context

attempts.selectStep: Select a Step for attempt evidence
attempts.selectStepHelp: Select a Step in the list to review its physical attempts and then reproduction facts when needed.

failureHistory.title: Seen before
failureHistory.rule: {{failures}} same-plan step failures found in {{considered}} earlier runs. Only exact signature matches are shown.
failureHistory.contextUnknown: some execution identities were not recorded
failureHistory.none: No earlier exact match for this failure signature.
failureHistory.contract: Exact signature means the same plan, repository, step, exit/reason, evidence stream and output hash. This is evidence grouping, not root-cause inference.
failureHistory.recurredAfterPass: Exact failure reappeared after a pass
failureHistory.noLaterPass: No later comparable passing run is recorded in this Journal cut.
failureHistory.recoveryRule: A later pass proves only that the same admitted step later passed. It does not identify the cause or prove the failure was permanently fixed.
failureHistory.contextCoverage: {{known}}/{{total}} context identities recorded on both runs
failureHistory.contextEvidenceRule: Counts compare exact failures and later passes with the inspected failure across workspace, runtime, toolchain, isolation, and exact command. They are evidence only, not cause attribution.
failureHistory.sequenceRule: Shows up to {{limit}} nearest comparable runs on each side of the selected failure.
failureHistory.sameContextLaterPasses: Later passes in the same complete context
failureHistory.sameContextLaterExactFailures: Later exact failures in the same complete context
failureHistory.sameContextRecurrenceAfterPass: Exact same-context failure after a same-context pass
failureHistory.sequenceContract: Sequence order comes from the same verified Journal read cut. Status, signature relation, and context are recorded facts; no cause, flake, trend, or recovery label is inferred.
failureHistory.transitionsRule: Compares only adjacent runs in the visible comparable sequence. Context differences are evidence, not an explanation for the outcome change.
failureHistory.transitionsContract: Transition facts compare adjacent canonical runs only. A context change before an outcome change does not prove that the context change caused the outcome.
failureHistory.contextWindowValue: {{prior}} contiguous earlier · selected · {{later}} contiguous later ({{total}} runs total)

team.title: Repository execution composition
team.contract: Observed overlap is derived from recorded repository timestamps. It describes what happened; it does not create cross-repository dependencies or scheduling semantics.

observability.title: What evidence survives
observability.contract: Durable execution facts remain in run history. Raw stdout/stderr is bounded, process-local, sealed briefly after terminal execution, and then unavailable.

issues.title: Start with these failures
issues.contract: These are canonical run/repository/step failure facts rolled up for navigation. Ordering is deterministic; Game Tape does not infer root cause or severity.
issues.focusFailuresHelp: Failure focus keeps every Step available while quieting Passed graphics. No execution data is filtered or reordered.

evidence.artifactRule: Artifacts stay attached to the Step that produced or declared them.
evidence.previewUnavailable: Game Tape records artifact evidence, not artifact bytes or MIME type, so content preview is not inferred in the browser.

state.PLANNED: Planned. Execution has not been admitted yet.
state.ADMITTED: Admitted. The run may begin when execution capacity is available.
state.RUNNING: Running. Follow CI/CD Flow for the current Step, Timeline for timing, or Logs for exact Step output and failure evidence.
state.PASSED: Completed successfully. CI/CD Flow shows the admitted sequence that ran; Logs and Technical evidence retain the exact review facts.
state.ATTENTION_REQUIRED: Completed with attention required. Start with the highlighted issues, use CI/CD Flow for sequence context, then open Logs for exact Step evidence.
state.FAILED: Failed. Start with Failure focus, use CI/CD Flow to see where execution stopped, then open the exact Step in Logs.
state.CANCELLED: Cancelled. Evidence recorded before cancellation remains available.
state.INTERRUPTED: Interrupted. Review the interruption evidence before deciding whether to run again.
state.NOT_RUN: Not run. Review the recorded disposition to see why execution did not start.
state.SKIPPED: Skipped. Review the recorded Step disposition; Game Tape does not infer a reason beyond that fact.

readmit-placement.title: Execution placement was lost
readmit-placement.description: Retry placement creates a new admission from this exact failed run and preserves readmission lineage. It does not reconstruct the target in the browser.

run-same-target.title: Fix the failure, then rerun the same recorded target
run-same-target.description: This starts a new run with the exact durable target and repository set recorded here. Oh Goon does not infer that the underlying problem is fixed.

open-recovery.title: Do not replay this run yet
open-recovery.description: Repository effects may be uncertain or partially committed. Inspect Recovery evidence before any new execution so effects are not repeated blindly.

launch.title: Launch Manifest receipt
launch.unmanaged: This run was admitted outside a managed Launch Manifest. Game Tape does not invent launch identity.
launch.contract: Desired launch intent and observed backend facts were captured at RUN_ADMITTED. Game Tape preserves that historical receipt and never substitutes the current application launch.

whyNot.title: Why execution was refused
whyNot.rule: This explanation is derived from the durable run failure; it is not a separate execution authority.

configuration.title: Configuration explanation
configuration.privacy: Values are withheld. These decisions were captured during resolution; this view grants no execution authority.
configuration.unavailable: Configuration lineage was not retained for this Run.
configuration.empty: No input or environment decisions were captured.
configuration.omitted: Additional decisions omitted from bounded evidence: {{count}}

campaign.title: Agent campaign Journal
campaign.incomplete: This Journal view is incomplete. The current campaign outcome cannot be confirmed from this view.
campaign.noInference: Child Run success does not establish campaign completion. Readback never resumes work.
campaign.records: Campaign intent, phase linkage and decisions
campaign.unavailableRecord: This record has no usable fact classification.
campaign.unstartedRule: This record retains a selection that was not admitted; it does not represent an executed Run.

attention.title: Fleet attention
attention.description: Focus on what currently needs action. Resolved issues disappear automatically from this view.
attention.clearMessage: No included repository currently needs attention or rechecking.

review.readyTitle: {{count}} repositories have verified changes ready for review
review.readyMessage: Create a local branch and commit only the accepted uv.lock changes. Nothing is pushed.

commands.title: Fleet Command Center
commands.description: Run supported UV checks and tasks across included repositories under the same cancellation, history, and execution-safety model.
commands.taskDescription: Run one explicitly entered executable with uv run --frozen across the fleet. No shell string is accepted.
commands.executionNote: Commands execute as canonical {{action}} fleet runs.

security.title: Fleet Security & SBOM
security.description: Aggregate uv audit findings across the fleet and turn affected packages into targeted remediation plans.

migration.title: Adopt UV
migration.description: Discover Python repositories that are not yet UV-managed and safely migrate only deterministic project shapes. Poetry, PDM, Rye, and ambiguous requirements stay review-only.

onboarding.title: Get started with oh-goon
onboarding.description: Choose the parent folder that contains your local Git repositories. Adding it only saves the path and discovers repositories; nothing is executed or modified.

folder.title: Add a repository location
folder.message: Choose the parent folder containing your local Git repositories.

check.title: Review your repositories
check.message: See which repositories are ready and run a repository’s own CI/CD directly from Repositories.

automate.title: Run across repositories
automate.message: Use Runs → New shared run for explicit ad hoc multi-repository execution, or create a Schedule for an explicit repository target set.

review.title: Review in Runs
review.message: Open Overview, Timeline and Logs after execution; technical evidence stays one disclosure deeper.

preview.title: Preview updates
preview.description: See what dependency resolution would change.

review.title: Prepare review
review.description: Create local review commits for verified updates.

apply.title: Update repositories
apply.description: Apply the planned dependency changes safely.

add-repositories.title: Add your repositories
add-repositories.message: Choose a parent folder before running maintenance.

running.title: A run is in progress

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.body: Start on Repositories for repository state and CI/CD. Use Runs → New shared run for one Plan across repositories, Schedules for future repository automation, and Runs for execution evidence.

firstUpdate.title: Your first repository run
firstUpdate.body: Open Repositories, choose a repository, and press Run CI/CD when backend verification allows it. The resulting Run appears automatically in Runs and Game Tape.

issues.title: When a run needs attention
issues.body: Start with the highlighted issue in Game Tape, then open the exact Step in Logs. Fix the underlying repository or environment problem and start a new run when ready.

results.title: Understanding results
results.body: Runs shows current progress and keeps exact durable reports. Technical reason codes, policy IDs, and diagnostics are available when you expand technical details.

review.title: Reviewing exact evidence
review.body: Overview is human-first. Exact Fleet Run/Plan/source identity, execution receipts and environment fingerprints stay under Technical evidence and receipts.

advanced.title: Advanced tools
advanced.body: Enable Advanced mode in Settings only when you need the full UV Command Center, migration tools, provenance, recovery tooling, or deeper repository controls.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.body: If the app cannot run a check, open Settings → Advanced to inspect tool health. Keep repository problems visible; do not use destructive Git commands just to clear an error.

hockeyTeam.title: The team behind a predictable run
hockeyTeam.body: Hockey names make the safety model memorable. They explain canonical oh-goon facts; they do not create a second runtime or hide the technical reason a run stopped.

diagnostics.title: Handled diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Handled application errors are recorded once here with sensitive local details redacted.

roster.title: Locker Room roster
roster.rule: Humor may rename an explanation, never a guarantee.

enforcer.name: The Enforcer
enforcer.tagline: Bad config never gets a first shift.
enforcer.owner: Canonical admission and repository baseline validation.
enforcer.boundary: Rejected admission means no pipeline effect has started.

equipmentManager.name: The Equipment Manager
equipmentManager.tagline: Only approved gear reaches the bench.
equipmentManager.owner: Executor inventory, exact host tools, prepared runtimes, and pinned deployment facts.
equipmentManager.boundary: No PATH guessing, ambient tool discovery, or undeclared runtime authority.

warmUp.name: Warm-Up
warmUp.tagline: Fast because preparation is explicit—not because yesterday leaked into today.
warmUp.boundary: No ambient cache inheritance, latest lookup, or cross-team leftovers.

redTeam.name: The Red Team
redTeam.tagline: Find known bad gear before it matters.
redTeam.owner: Declared typed security/audit checks that actually exist in the resolved plan.
redTeam.boundary: The UI never claims a universal scanner, threshold, or allowlist that the runtime cannot evidence.

scout.name: The Scout
scout.owner: Resolved-plan diagnostics and bounded execution evidence.
scout.boundary: Secret bytes are never printed; variable values are not dumped by default.

trainer.name: The Trainer
trainer.tagline: Another shift only when the playbook already allowed it.
trainer.boundary: No autonomous failure classification or surprise retry after the fact.

coach.name: The Coach
coach.tagline: Can suggest. Cannot overrule the game.
coach.owner: Advisory projections derived from canonical facts.
coach.boundary: Advice cannot alter admission, order, retry, mutation authority, or settlement.

linesman.name: The Linesman
linesman.tagline: The boundary was decided before the puck dropped.
linesman.owner: Compiled filesystem, network, secret, tool, process, and isolation authority.
linesman.boundary: No sidecar watcher and no second violation state machine.

penaltyBox.name: The Penalty Box
penaltyBox.tagline: Unsafe to guess means no automatic replay.
penaltyBox.boundary: Normal known failures do not become quarantine; ambiguous dangerous effects do.

goalie.name: The Goalie
goalie.tagline: Nothing leaves the rink on vibes.
goalie.boundary: Signing, scanning, provenance, or rollout checks are shown only when exact evidence exists.

zamboni.name: The Zamboni
zamboni.tagline: Fresh ice for the next team.
zamboni.boundary: Only explicit repository-owned durable facts/content may cross runs.

mascot.name: The Mascot
mascot.owner: ASCII/product chrome derived from existing UI state.
mascot.boundary: Never schedules work, changes status, or hides a failed run.

penaltyBox.title: Quarantined effects: {{count}} — evidence-first recovery required
penaltyBox.description: These are ambiguous or unsafe repository effects, not ordinary failed steps. Automatic replay stays blocked until canonical reconciliation proves what happened.

shiftReport.title: Game Tape step evidence
shiftReport.description: Exact step timing, outcome, attempts, and executed tool evidence. Boundary, cache, and egress facts have one owner in the Game Sheet.
shiftReport.noAttempts: No attempt evidence was recorded for this step.
shiftReport.retryDeclared: {{count}} attempts recorded — every extra attempt must be explained by canonical Trainer evidence.
shiftReport.boundaryRule: Linesman view: this is the boundary evidence that actually ran; no watcher or inferred policy is added.
shiftReport.egressRule: Goalie view: artifacts and outputs below are the bytes the runtime actually evidenced. Missing evidence is never promoted to a pass.
shiftReport.gameSheetRule: Game Tape owns the step timeline; the Game Sheet owns admission, runtime authority, cache lineage, boundaries, and egress evidence.

trustReceipt.title: Game Sheet — trust receipt
trustReceipt.description: Canonical Fleet Plan evidence arranged for fast inspection. Only allowlisted metadata, policy IDs, references, and digests are shown.

admission.title: Admission receipt
admission.notRecorded: No repository-admission receipt is attached to this operation evidence. The UI makes no admission claim beyond the evidence it has.

runtime.title: Runtime and toolchain authority
runtime.hostEnvironmentNames: Declared host environment names — names only
runtime.notRecorded: No execution-input authority evidence is attached to this operation.

cache.title: Explicit preparation and cache lineage
cache.noAttemptCache: No attempt-level cache input/output or retained reference was recorded. Nothing is inferred from absence.
cache.notRecorded: No execution-input lineage evidence is attached to this operation.

boundaries.title: Boundary sheet
boundaries.notRecorded: No attempt boundary evidence was recorded for these steps.

egress.title: Egress manifest
egress.rule: Digest evidence proves what the runtime recorded. It does not imply signing, scanning, deployment, or any other check that has no corresponding evidence.

teardown.title: Verified attempt teardown
teardown.rule: Zamboni proves only the step attempt-private filesystem roots recorded by the canonical runtime. It does not claim that durable retained cache/content was deleted or that unsupported external cleanup occurred.

finalWhistle.cleanPassRule: Clean pass means the recorded Fleet Plan steps did not fail and every strict step has canonical attempt-root teardown evidence. It is not a signing, vulnerability, deployment-readiness, or external-system guarantee.

release.noCanonicalEffect: No canonical release effect was recorded for this release step. The Goalie does not infer an external change from workspace files or step naming.
release.none: This plan has no release-capable steps. The Goalie has nothing to clear.
release.failedAfterRelease: External release evidence exists although the overall run failed. Bytes or desired state crossed the release boundary; do not read the failed run as “nothing left the rink”.

readiness.notRun: Verification did not run. A prior hard gate stopped the linear plan before this observation step.
readiness.noCanonicalVerification: The rollout step has no canonical readiness receipt. The Goalie does not infer health from a step name, log text, or workspace file.
readiness.notRequested: No explicit kubernetes_rollout_verify step was admitted. Release evidence is available, but post-release readiness was not requested or proven by this plan.
readiness.rule: Release and readiness are separate facts. Goalie reports only the exact generation/image observation recorded by the explicit read-only rollout step; it never runs a hidden watcher or retries a release.
